value.rationale: A minimal and natural forbidden-factor constraint (aaa) on a classical automaton presents a motivated recovery/control problem. Establishing the exact universally feasible maximum-run threshold two, all-order constructive recovery and 22 exact shortest constrained lengths gives a reusable nontrivial benchmark. It is not a cosmetic renaming of the unconstrained threshold.
